request.style: English, male country voice, solo with harmony, acoustic guitar, fiddle, upright bass, piano, slow mournful mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Pekah son of Remaliah rose
Fifty men of Gilead close
In Samaria’s royal seat
The king of Israel’s defeat
He killed the man he served
To take the crown he deserved
Reigned for twenty years long
In the days of Israel’s song

[Chorus]
Be careful, keep calm, do not be afraid
Do not lose heart over the anger displayed
Two smoldering stubs of firewood burn
While the kings of the north and south turn

[Verse]
Rezin of Aram marched up
Against Jerusalem’s cup
They laid siege but could not prevail
The heart shook like a tree in the gale
Word came to David’s house
Aram joined the northern cause
Ahaz sent messengers away
To Tiglath-Pileser’s day

[Chorus]
Be careful, keep calm, do not be afraid
Do not lose heart over the anger displayed
Two smoldering stubs of firewood burn
While the kings of the north and south turn

[Bridge]
Tiglath-Pileser came strong
Capturing Ijon and Abel Beth Maacah along
Deporting the people far away
To Assyria’s end of day

[Outro]
Hoshea son of Elah conspired
Killed the king who aspired
Became king in his place
In the twenty year’s grace
